mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage (tenant_id, period, scene, call_count, input_tokens, output_tokens) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{period}, #{scene}, #{callCount}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_count = call_count + #{callCount}, input_tokens = input_tokens + #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = output_tokens + #{outputTokens}
